name: competitor-change-watcher
description: Finds what changed in competitor changelogs and pricing pages you paste (one block per competitor and source, up to 100,000 characters): new entries since your last paste in this conversation, or the difference between a Before and an After text, with price changes per plan (old, new, percent) computed in code. Each change is classified (feature, pricing, integration, deprecation, security, other) with a verbatim quote, and mapped to the roadmap issues in your connected issue tracker that it affects, marking ones you already shipped. Read-only: it never opens web pages itself, posts or edits issues, and never invents a change, a price or a roadmap link. Follow-ups: questions about the report, as json. Not a market-research or news agent.

skills.name: Competitor changes
skills.description: New competitor changelog entries and price changes from pasted text, classified with verbatim quotes and mapped to the roadmap issues they affect.
examples: Here are two changelogs and a pricing page, what changed?
Map these competitor changes to our roadmap
